scientific_limitations: Applies to the indicated restriction of scalars of the rank-two free class-three nilpotent Lie algebra, m>=2; does not classify arbitrary class-three Lie algebras or all automorphism stabilizers. Numerical tests are finite. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: The ideal lattice and projective abelian-subalgebra geometry of scalar-restricted free class-three Lie algebras
